cfb.bowl_selection_state.measurement: For each draw of cfb.rating_posterior_draws simulate remaining games. Per team: countable_wins = wins over FBS opponents + min(1, wins over FCS opponents that averaged >= 90% of the permissible maximum football grants-in-aid per year over the rolling two-year period, i.e. >= 56.7, or hold an approved waiver); wins over non-Division I opponents, ties and forfeits = 0. Deserving if countable_wins >= overall regular-season losses (12 games: 6-6; 13 games: 7-6, a 6-7 team is an alternate); a loss in the conference championship game does not remove deserving status. Reclassifying FCS-to-FBS programs are treated as regular FBS members from 2026 (Proposal 2026-31). Remove the CFP field first, then allocate deserving teams in each season's bowl pick order: each bowl takes the best remaining team of its tie-in conference by score = countable_wins + 0.5 x (AP-ranked flag) + logit draw term (multinomial logit on wins, rank, conference, travel distance fitted on 2014-2025 selections). If deserving teams < open slots, fill in the legislated order: (1) teams whose only shortfall is a non-qualifying FCS win with a denied waiver, (2) 13-game 6-7 teams, (3) 5-7 teams with a multiyear APR permitting postseason play; for 2026 onward the unfilled tie-in's conference picks its own 5-7 team by the same score (no APR order), for 2014-2025 backtests use descending multiyear APR. Output P(selected) per team and P(deserving < slots) per season. Re-run weekly as of latest results; no market input.
raw_data: season schedule and results with opponent division per game (FBS, FCS, non-Division I)
FCS opponent two-year average football grants-in-aid (90% threshold, 56.7 per year) or NCAA waiver decision per counted FCS win
conference championship game results (deserving status preserved on a loss)
bowl tie-in table and pick order by conference and year
